name: Vibrant_paint
title: Vibrant Paint
author: TheAechbomb
description:
Improves paint color and maximum saturation on all entities that can be painted, so: The Engineer, Cars, Locomotives, Trainstops, Gun Turrets etc... Great for color-coding trains! (Theoretical) Mod support for AAI Ironclad, Warden, Flame & Laser Tanks, and One more Hovercraft. AAI Warden retextured to match lighting and contrast of other vehicles. Compatible with FactorioHD!  To color your vehicles individually, install DMV - Directionally Moving Vehicles!

Originally 'Oil Based Paint', made by Preston Lee ℭole ( https://mods.factorio.com/mod/Oil_Based_Paint )

updated for 2.0 and Space Age by TheAechBomb.
